items.description: Pneumatic launch tube for C-130/KC-135 and S0

notes: Active collaborative engineering phase with Ultra PCS/USAF on pneumatic launcher design for C-130/KC-135 and S0 aircraft. Tracy Harris pursuing Royal Navy interest and UK-US funding pathways. Multiple BST engineers engaged in technical discussions on UAV dimensions, tube interface (Sonobuoy A vs. CLT), ejection velocity, and acceleration requirements. Pre-sales technical phase with no PO or invoice yet.
